# UpdateScope

UpdateScope is the move-only RAII token for one Window update-depth level; it guarantees balanced close and makes an explicit layout barrier available without opening a nested native loop.

## Visual evidence

![UpdateScope control capture](captures/native_window_host.png)

The showcased retained tree is constructed and mutated through nested Window update transactions before host paint.
